description_en: Updates the information of a virtual resource group
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-virtual-resource --cluster-id cn-hangzhou --virtual-resource-id eas-vr-npovr28onap1xxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVirtualResource

parameters.help_en: The region where the virtual resource group resides
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟资源组所在的地域
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual resource group
parameters.name: virtual_resource_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to disable the protection period for spot instances
parameters.help_zh: 是否关闭竞价型实例保留时长
parameters.name: disable_spot_protection_period

fields.help_en:
The instance type of the public resource group.
<notice>You must specify exactly one of the following fields: InstanceType, ResourceId, and QuotaId.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
公共资源组机型规格。
<notice>用户必须指定InstanceType、ResourceId和QuotaId中的一个字段，且只能指定一个。></notice>
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en: The scheduling priority of the resource. A larger value indicates a higher scheduling priority
fields.help_zh: 资源调度优先级。数字越大，调度优先级越高
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The Lingjun resource quota ID.
<notice>You must specify exactly one of the following fields: InstanceType, ResourceId, and QuotaId.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
灵骏资源配额ID。
<notice>用户必须指定InstanceType、ResourceId和QuotaId中的一个字段，且只能指定一个。></notice>
fields.name: quota_id

fields.help_en: The region where the resource resides
fields.name: region

fields.help_en:
The ID of the dedicated resource group. For more information about how to query the ID of a dedicated resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html.
<notice>You must specify exactly one of the following fields: InstanceType, ResourceId, and QuotaId.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
专属资源组ID。如何查询专属资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html。
<notice>用户必须指定InstanceType、ResourceId和QuotaId中的一个字段，且只能指定一个。></notice>
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The maximum price for spot instances in the public resource group.
<notice>If not specified, spot instances are not used.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
公共资源组抢占实例价格上限。
<notice>不设置代表不使用抢占式实例。></notice>
fields.name: spot_price_limit

parameters.help_en:
The list of resources contained in the virtual resource group.
<notice>If specified, the previous data is overwritten.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟资源组包含的资源列表。
<notice>如果指定，将会覆盖先前的数据。></notice>
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en: The new name of the virtual resource group
parameters.name: virtual_resource_name
